blocking_findings.title: Conditional Level-B surfaces contradict or exceed the frozen intervention-channel semantics
evidence: V2 globally canonicalizes phase to [-pi,pi), prohibits exact +pi, and declares -pi the sole endpoint representative, but both T6 and T7 Level-B phase grids explicitly contain +pi.
GF_E_SLOW_SINE is frozen at amplitude 0.8, while T1 and T2 Level B require other amplitudes without a parameterized mapping or combination rule.
GF_E_SO_PULSE is frozen at repetition 0.85 Hz, while T3 Level B requires five repetition frequencies without exact onset-sample scheduling.

GF_TR_SIGMA_PACKET_BALANCE, GF_TR_SIGMA_CONTINUOUS_BALANCE, and GF_T_PHASE_LOCKED_PACKET freeze 13 Hz waveforms, while T4, T5, and T7 Level B require 11-15 Hz carriers without replacement formulas or propagation into attribution and scheduler rules.
GF_T_PHASE_LOCKED_PACKET freezes amplitude 1.0, while T6 Level B requires amplitudes 0-1.0 without an exact generalized packet rule.
T8 Level B requires exposure fractions within each 25-second window but does not freeze the on/off placement, sample indices, transition convention, or interaction with window classification.
blocking_findings.impact: The prospectively frozen optional surfaces can be implemented in multiple scientifically different ways, and two of them request a phase value the same protocol prohibits. Level-B family membership, run identities, compute accounting, mechanistic support, and Grade C dependencies are therefore not reproducible.
required_next_version_correction: Use only unique canonical phase conditions and remove or replace +pi consistently across every artifact.
Freeze exact parameterized formulas, bounds, sample schedules, combination rules, and sham semantics for every second Level-B coordinate.
Propagate carrier/amplitude/frequency changes into packet, attribution, detector, family-member, run-count, and compute rules.
Freeze exact T8 exposure start/stop samples and boundary behavior for every fraction.

blocking_findings.title: Policy selection and the 8-by-8 cross-target scalar are not deterministically defined
evidence: The protocol selects the smallest-absolute-dose maximizer of a registered target-benefit score, but no exact per-condition score and no aggregation across each target's multiple efficacy components is frozen.
T1 and T7 are tracking problems whose requested condition changes across the grid, so a single fixed row policy cannot be inferred from endpoint contrast language alone.
F_LEVEL_B_SURFACES refers to a target-oriented normalized effect-minus-one for each cell without defining that scalar for any target.
F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8 divides each cell by that column target's practical margin even though T1-T7 contain multiple margins, often in different units, and no canonical component or aggregation is named.
blocking_findings.impact: Different conforming implementations can select different policies, populate different standardized effects, and assign different intended/beneficial/negligible/trade-off labels. The complete off-target requirement and Grade C cannot be adjudicated.
required_next_version_correction: Freeze G_i(u) or an equivalent per-condition scalar formula for every target, including orientation, baseline, aggregation, units, normalization, missingness, and ties.
Define whether a row policy is one condition, a requested-value mapping, or a multi-condition contrast for T1 and T7.
Freeze the exact scalar effect and adverse margin used for every cross-target column, including multi-component targets.
Make Level-B and cross-target family members mechanically enumerable from those formulas before outcomes.

blocking_findings.title: T7 decision statistics and Holm-driving Monte Carlo tests are not reproducibly specified
evidence: T7 requires circular-circular correlation rho_c but provides no formula; standard circular-correlation definitions are not equivalent.
The aggregation and exact wrapped formula for median tracking error and -pi/2 versus +pi/2 output separation are not frozen.

The common 100000-draw sign-flip test does not freeze the target test statistic, one- or two-sided tail, sign-vector generation/reset order, inclusion of the observed assignment, tie comparison, or Monte Carlo p-value correction.
The T7 circular-label permutation does not define which labels are permuted within which blocks, its statistic, tail, or p-value convention.
blocking_findings.impact: Target p-values, Holm decisions, T7 slacks, eligibility, grades, and claims can differ across implementations even with identical trajectories.
required_next_version_correction: Freeze exact formulas and aggregation units for rho_c, tracking error, and circular separation.
Freeze one test statistic and alternative for each target, the exact randomization unit and generator lifecycle, treatment of zeros/ties/missing blocks, and the finite-Monte-Carlo p-value formula.
Freeze the circular permutation operation and Holm sort/tie convention.

blocking_findings.title: A mandatory PASS_ALL preflight test depends on an unbound fixture manifest
evidence: PF_T4_EVENT_ATTRIBUTION requires exact agreement with a frozen hand-calculated fixture manifest.
No exact event table, expected accepted-pair list, expected class/count values, or fixture-manifest path and hash is embedded in or bound by the seven-artifact Candidate V2 manifest.
blocking_findings.impact: The required PASS_ALL detector preflight cannot be independently reproduced or hash-verified, so the Phase2A preflight gate cannot close without creating an unfrozen expected answer.
blocking_findings.required_next_version_correction: Embed the exact fixture inputs and expected outputs or bind a separate immutable fixture artifact by exact path and SHA-256, then specify the executable comparison and failure output.
